claims: Yellowstone National Park was established in 1872.
Yellowstone National Park is America's first national park.
Yellowstone National Park is a 3,500-square-mile wilderness.
Yellowstone National Park is atop a volcanic hotspot.
Yellowstone National Park is primarily in Wyoming.
Yellowstone National Park features 10,000+ hydrothermal features.
Key areas of Yellowstone National Park include Yellowstone Lake, Canyon Village, and Mammoth Hot Springs.
Yellowstone National Park rules require staying on boardwalks near hot springs to avoid boiling water.
Yellowstone National Park rules require maintaining at least 100 yards from bears and wolves.
Yellowstone National Park rules require maintaining at least 25 yards from bison and elk.
Yellowstone National Park Lodges operates 9 lodges.
Yellowstone National Park Lodges operates several campgrounds.
Yellowstone National Park camping and lodging is booked via Recreation.gov.
West Yellowstone, MT offers the most direct access to many attractions in Yellowstone National Park.
Gardiner, MT is near the north entrance of Yellowstone National Park.
Gardiner, MT is close to Mammoth Hot Springs.
Cody, WY has proximity to the east entrance of Yellowstone National Park.
A 59-second YouTube video from Yellowstone Universe was posted on Nov 10, 2024.
There is a TV series called "Yellowstone".
The TV series "Yellowstone" is a drama starring Kevin Costner.
The TV series "Yellowstone" follows a ranching family in Montana.
The TV series "Yellowstone" often depicts a ranching family in conflict with the national park and developers.
